product_from_film: Toku presents payroll that reaches remote workers and can be used for everyday spending.
explains_well: A payroll table is followed by a worker payment notification and a card-payment confirmation in different locations.
unclear: The film does not show payroll setup, fees, currency conversion, eligibility or actual settlement time.
scenario: A sender uses a payroll table, remote workers receive or view funds, and a person pays at a waterfront shop.
product_clear_basis: Toku You got paid notification at 7–8s links the opening payroll-like table to a recipient; This is payroll now names the category at 18s.

categories.finding: Sender table → remote recipient notification → another account-value scene → everyday payment → payroll brand.
San Francisco and a desk worker give immediate geographic context; a payment-like table appears by 1s.
Payroll function becomes clear with paid notification at 7s and explicit payroll line at 18s. Remote workers are the shown audience.
City labels build, notifications appear and USDG values change. Exact payment latency and motion easing are unverified.
Location changes are bridged by work devices and money states; each new city receives a large label.
Warm wood, café brick, sunlight and waterfront scenes make finance visible through daily settings.
City names, paid notification and success amount carry the message. Detailed payroll rows and partner names are secondary.
Voice delivery is unverified.

Effects and their sources are unverified.

categories.finding: Silent viewing shows money sent/received and spent across locations, though the precise account and growth mechanisms remain unclear.
Large city text first locates each person, then device and notification close-ups show the financial action.
Three money contexts fit into 18s before branding; this gives broad clarity but little operational detail.
The global-work opening is paid off by a recipient notification and an everyday purchase.
Comfortable work settings and green success cues may suggest ease and normality; viewer reaction is unmeasured.
Laptops, phones and payment states connect different people; no single identified payment is tracked across all scenes.
Paid and purchase confirmations are shown states. Actual settlement, yield, fees, jurisdictional access and stablecoin handling are unverified.
Toku notification and final payroll line distinguish the offer; location footage alone could fit other global-money services.
One clearly matching sender amount and recipient amount would strengthen the causal payment story.
categories.experiment: Show one payroll row and the same recipient amount in the notification, with actual elapsed time if measured.

lessons.keep: Follow the financial interface with a person receiving and using the money in a familiar setting.

lessons.open: Fees, eligibility, conversion, settlement, amount-growth basis, location authenticity and audio remain unverified.
